description_en: Modifies the feature configurations of a PolarDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 修改PolarDB MySQL集群的功能配置
kebab_example: aliyun polardb modify-db-cluster --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000 --standby-ha-mode ON --data-sync-mode AsynSync --fault-simulate-mode 0 --storage-auto-scale Enable --compress-storage ON --storage-upper-bound 800 --db-node-crash-list pi-rwxxx --fault-injection-type 0 --imci-auto-index OFF --table-meta tables_:_name_:_testtb_,_type_:_table_,_newname_:_testtb_restore_,_name_:_testdb_,_type_:_db_,_newname_:_testdb_restore --modify-row-compression OFF --connection-resource-quota 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBCluster

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.
> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173433.html operation to query information about all clusters in the specified region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
>您可以调用DescribeDBClusters接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The cross-zone automatic switchover mode of the cluster. Valid values:

- **ON**: enables cross-zone automatic switchover.
- **OFF**: disables cross-zone automatic switchover
parameters.help_zh:
集群的跨可用区自动切换模式，取值范围如下：

- **ON**：开启跨可用区自动切换。
- **OFF**：关闭跨可用区自动切换
parameters.name: standby_ha_mode

parameters.help_en:
The cross-zone data replication mode of the cluster. Valid values:

- **AsyncSync**: asynchronous
- **SemiSync**: semi-synchronous
parameters.help_zh:
集群的跨可用区数据复制方式，取值范围如下：

- **AsyncSync**：异步。
- **SemiSync**：半同步
parameters.name: data_sync_mode

parameters.help_en:
The dimension of the disaster recovery drill for the cluster. Valid values:
- `0` or `FaultInjection`: primary zone-level disaster recovery drill.
- `1`: node-level disaster recovery drill.
> - In the **primary zone-level disaster recovery drill** scenario, all compute nodes in the primary zone become unavailable. The failover in this scenario causes service interruptions.
> - In the **node-level disaster recovery drill** scenario, only a single compute node is supported for the drill. Specify the desired compute node name by using `DBNodeCrashList`
parameters.help_zh:
集群的故障演练维度。取值范围如下：
- `0`或`FaultInjection`：主可用区维度故障演练。
- `1`：节点维度故障演练。
> - **主可用区维度故障演练**场景，主可用区所有的计算节点均不可用，该场景的容灾切换是有损的。
> - **节点维度故障演练**场景，仅支持单个计算节点进行演练，通过`DBNodeCrashList`传入期望计算节点名
parameters.name: fault_simulate_mode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic storage scaling for the Standard Edition cluster. Valid values:

- Enable: enables automatic storage scaling.
- Disable: disables automatic storage scaling
parameters.help_zh:
标准版集群是否开启存储自动扩容。取值范围如下：

- Enable：开启存储自动扩容。
- Disable：关闭存储自动扩容
parameters.name: storage_auto_scale

parameters.help_en: Enables storage compression. Set the value to **ON**
parameters.name: compress_storage

parameters.help_en:
The upper limit for automatic storage scaling of the Standard Edition cluster. Unit: GB.

> The maximum value is 32000
parameters.help_zh:
标准版集群存储自动扩容上限，单位：GB。

> 取值最大为32000
parameters.name: storage_upper_bound

parameters.help_en:
The list of node instance names for the disaster recovery drill.
> Node-level drills support only a single node. For zone-level drills, you can leave this parameter empty or specify all nodes
parameters.help_zh:
演练节点实例名列表。
> 节点维度的演练只支持单个节点，可用区维度的演练可不传该参数，或传入所有节点
parameters.name: db_node_crash_list

parameters.help_en:
The fault injection method. Valid values:

- 0: instance fault injection based on `Crash SQL`
parameters.help_zh:
故障注入方式。取值范围如下：

- 0：基于`Crash SQL`的实例故障注入
parameters.name: fault_injection_type

parameters.help_en:
The automatic IMCI-based query acceleration feature. Valid values:
- `ON`: enabled.
- `OFF`: disabled.

> - Only PolarDB for MySQL clusters are supported.
> - For cluster version requirements, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2854119.html
parameters.help_zh:
自动列存索引提速功能。取值范围如下：
- `ON`：开启。
- `OFF`：关闭。

> - 仅支持PolarDB MySQL版集群。
> - 集群版本限制，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2854119.html
parameters.name: imci_auto_index
